verse: ਸਭਨਾ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਇਕੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਵਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
translation: The One Lord is the Giver of all beings; may I never forget Him.

verse: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਵੇਲਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ॥
translation: Blessed is that time when I met the True Guru.
Service to the Guru is reflection on the Shabad.
Chanting the Name, the mind becomes pure.
The Name is the medicine to cure all diseases.

verse: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
translation: The Guru is always with me, ever present.

verse: ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਤਾ ਤੂ ਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਾਤਾ ॥
translation: You are my Father, and You are my Mother.

verse: ਮਾਨਸ ਕੀ ਜਾਤ ਸਬੈ ਏਕੈ ਪਹਿਚਾਨਬੋ ॥
translation: Recognize the whole human race as one.

verse: ਮਿਠਤੁ ਨੀਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਤਤੁ ॥
translation: Sweetness and humility are the essence of all virtues.

verse: ਸਭੇ ਸਾਝੀਵਾਲ ਸਦਾਇਨਿ ਤੂੰ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦਿਸਹਿ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
translation: All are partners in Your sharing; You are alien to none.

verse: ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੇਵ ਕਮਾਈਐ ॥ ਤਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਬੈਸਣੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
translation: In the midst of this world, do service, and you shall find a seat in the Court of the Lord.

verse: ਜਿਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕੀਓ ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਇਓ ॥
translation: Only those who love, find God.

verse: ਦੇਹ ਸਿਵਾ ਬਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਇਹੈ ਸੁਭ ਕਰਮਨ ਤੇ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨ ਟਰੋਂ ॥
translation: Grant me this boon, O Lord, that I may never hesitate from performing good deeds.

verse: ਸੋ ਕਿਉ ਮੰਦਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਜਿਤੁ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾਨ ॥
translation: So why call her bad? From her, kings are born.

verse: ਭੈ ਕਾਹੂ ਕਉ ਦੇਤ ਨਹਿ ਨਹਿ ਭੈ ਮਾਨਤ ਆਨ ॥
translation: One who does not frighten anyone, and who is not afraid of anyone.

verse: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
translation: Amongst all is the Light-You are that Light.

verse: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
translation: My True Guru is eternal; He does not come or go.
In this Dark Age, the Praise of the Lord is supreme.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੰਤਿਆ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, the Messenger of Death says nothing to you.

verse: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਦੇ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ॥
translation: All beings belong to Him; He belongs to all.
Show Mercy, O God, Merciful to the meek.
Taking the support of the Lotus Feet, one is saved.

verse: ਸੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਗੀ ਭਏ ਦੁਖ ਮਹਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
translation: In good times, there are many companions; in bad times, there is no one.

verse: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਦੇਸੁ ਜਹਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
translation: Blessed is that land where You dwell.

verse: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
translation: Chanting the Name, the mind and body blossom forth.
Meeting the Guru, I chant the Name.
Meditating on the Fearless Lord, all fear is dispelled.
Stay joined with the Society of the Saints.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
translation: Drinking the Lord's Essence, I have found eternal peace.
By His Grace, He has come to His own home.
The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor.

verse: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ ਦਿਉਹਾੜੀ ਸਦ ਵਾਰ ॥
translation: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, a hundred times a day.

verse: ਜਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਸੋ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਜੇ ॥
translation: Wherever my True Guru goes and sits, that place is beautiful.

verse: ਚੇਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਅਰਾਧੀਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਘਣਾ ॥
translation: In Chet, by meditating on God, a deep joy arises.

verse: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਚੜ੍ਹਦੀ ਕਲਾ ॥ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਾਣੇ ਸਰਬਤ ਦਾ ਭਲਾ ॥
translation: Nanak, with the Name, comes prosperity; by Thy Will, may everyone prosper.

verse: ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
translation: The Guru is always with me, ever present.

verse: ਵੈਸਾਖਿ ਧੀਰਨਿ ਕਿਉ ਵਾਢੀਆ ਜਿਨਾ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਿਛੋਹੁ ॥
translation: In Vaisakh, how can those be patient who are separated from their Beloved?

verse: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ॥
translation: Do not doubt, chant the Lord's Name.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਜੇਠਿ ਜੁੜੰਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਵੰਨਿ ॥
translation: In Jeth, we should unite with the Lord, before whom all bow.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
translation: Without the Lord, I cannot live for even a second.

verse: ਆਸਾੜੁ ਤਪੰਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਗੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ਨ ਜਿੰਨ੍ਹ੍ਹਨਾ ਪਾਸਿ ॥
translation: The month of Asaarh seems hot to those who are not with their Husband Lord.
The Perfect Guru has made my life complete.

verse: ਸਾਵਣਿ ਸਰਸੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
translation: In Sawan, the soul-bride is happy, if she is in love with the Lotus Feet of the Lord.
Life is useless without the Lord.
In Bhadoon, the soul-bride is deluded by doubt; she regrets her lost youth.
Chanting the Name, peace arises.

verse: ਅਸੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਉਮਾਹੜਾ ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸੁ ॥
translation: In Assu, the overflow of love is great; how can I obtain the Vision of the Lord?
The Creator is Merciful, the Provider is Compassionate.

verse: ਕਤਿਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਣੇ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜੋਗੁ ॥
translation: In Katak, perform good deeds; do not blame anyone else.
By Guru's Grace, understand this.

verse: ਮੰਘਿਰਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਸੋਹੰਦੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰ ॥
translation: In Magghar, they look beautiful, who sing the Praises of the Lord.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
translation: Sing the Lord's Praises, O my mind.

verse: ਪੋਖਿ ਤੁਸਾਰੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਕੰਠਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਹੁ ॥
translation: In Poh, the cold does not touch those who are held in the Lord's embrace.
The Lord is the Giver of all virtues.
Meeting the Perfect True Guru, I am enraptured.
Meditate forever on the Lord's Name.
The Name is a priceless treasure.
Those whom the Guru protects are saved.
Everywhere, You are my Protector.
I have taken sanctuary at the Lord's Feet.
Chanting the Name, the mind and body blossom forth.
The Perfect Guru gives the Lord's Name.
Meditating on the Lord's Name, suffering departs.

verse: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਾਏ ॥
translation: Through the Guru's Word, all virtues are obtained.
Meditating on the Lord, sins are washed away.
Chanting the Name, peace arises.
The Perfect Guru has made my life complete.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Name of the Lord is the support of my life.
By the True Guru's Instruction, the mind is purified.
My light has merged into the Divine Light.

verse: ਮਿਠਤੁ ਨੀਵੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਗੁਣ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਤਤੁ ॥
translation: Sweetness and humility are the essence of all virtues.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋਟਿ ਲਖ ਬਾਹਾ ॥
translation: The Name of the Lord is as powerful as millions of arms.
By Guru's Grace, enjoy the Love of the Lord.

verse: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਰਿਆ ॥
translation: Chanting the Name, the mind and body blossom forth.
The True Guru is the Giver of liberation.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤਿਆ ਕਛੁ n ਕਹੈ ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ॥
translation: Chanting the Name, the Messenger of Death says nothing to you.
The Perfect Guru has preserved my honor.
The Lord is the Giver of all peace.
With the Name as support, the mind is satisfied.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
translation: The Lotus Feet of the Lord are within my mind.
My True Guru is eternal, forever and ever.
Chanting the Name, peace is found.
Through the Guru's Word, one is saved.
Meditate on the Name of the Lord.
The One Lord is the Giver of all beings.
Show Mercy, O God, Merciful to the meek.

verse: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
translation: I have enshrined the Guru's feet within my mind.
Meditating on the Lord, pain does not touch you.
Chanting the Name, one is saved.
The Saints are the helpers of the Lord of the Universe.
By Guru's Grace, the supreme status is obtained.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
translation: Sing the Lord's Praises, O my mind.
O Nanak, meditate on the Name.
The Perfect Guru has made my life complete.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
translation: The Name of the Lord is the support of my life.
By the True Guru's Instruction, the mind is purified.
My light has merged into the Divine Light.
The Supreme Lord God is my Guru.
The Lord is the Giver of all virtues.
The Guru's Word is forever eternal.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਥਿਰੁ n ਕੋਈ ॥
translation: Without the Lord's Name, nothing is permanent.
Chanting the Name, the mind becomes cool and calm.

verse: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣਹੁ ॥
translation: Accept the Word of the True Guru as True, forever True.
The Gurmukh drinks the Ambrosial Nectar.
Drinking the Lord's Essence, I am forever satisfied.
The treasure of the Name is found by Guru's Grace.
Meeting the True Guru, my suffering is ended.

verse: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ॥
translation: Singing the Lord's Praises, there is eternal peace.

verse: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
translation: Listen to the Guru's Teachings, O my mind.
Chanting the Name, thirst is quenched.
I have woven the Lord's Name into my heart.
The Gurmukh obtains spiritual wisdom.
I have taken sanctuary at the Lord's Feet.
Chanting the Name, the mind and body blossom forth.
The Perfect Guru gives the Lord's Name.
Meditating on the Lord's Name, suffering departs.

Keep the treasure of the Name within your heart.
The Lotus Feet of the Lord are pure.
By Guru's Grace, meditate on the Name.

My True Guru is my helper forever.
Meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Taking sanctuary at the Lord's Feet.

The Guru's Word is forever permanent.
Chanting the Name, sins are washed away.
My True Guru is the support of my life.
Meditate on the Name of the Lord.

Chanting the Name, one is enraptured.
